The library specifically excludes digital California ID or driver's licenses. Call first to confirm your documents rather than relying on an old-address screenshot.

Oakland 工具通常借 7 天、最多 10 件，部分工具不能续借；这些是工具: Oakland tools have seven-day loans and a ten-item limit, with some nonrenewable tools. These differ from ordinary three-week book loans. Return tools inside the owning library during open hours, not through a book drop. Schedule both pickup and return travel.
借到之后：安排使用、清点与归还: After pickup: Plan the work, check parts, and return tools

编辑建议在借期前半段完成主要工作，留一两天清洁、补齐配件和归还。若项目要等另一件: Aim to finish the main task in the first half of the loan, leaving a day or two for cleaning, checking parts, and return. If another material has not arrived, delay pickup. Use the checkout record for renewals, charges, and item-specific restrictions.
取件时和工作人员一起确认配件数量、现有损伤、使用说明和防护需求。拍下附件摆放，回: At pickup, check accessories, existing damage, instructions, and protective equipment with staff. Photograph the accessory layout and follow the instructions. Stop and contact the library if something fails; do not repair its equipment or guess how to operate an unfamiliar power tool.
离馆太远、资格不符或工具被借走时，先算两次往返的时间。编辑建议比较附近商业租赁、: If the library is distant, you are ineligible, or the tool is unavailable, count two round trips. Compare nearby commercial rental, hiring someone for the single task, or rescheduling. A loan without rental charges still involves transport, consumables, and responsibility for damage.

Repair labor is free and donations are optional; needed parts, when available, are charged at cost. The usual limit is two items per household, subject to each event, and repairs are not guaranteed.
先排除主办方明确不收的东西，例如儿童安全座椅、医疗设备、燃气器具、电车或电动滑板: Check exclusions first, including car seats, medical devices, gas appliances, e-bike or scooter batteries, large appliances, and recalled items. Clothing repair is not the same as alterations. Different repair events accept different categories.
不用先买一袋猜测中的零件: Avoid buying a bag of guessed replacement parts
先带型号、故障视频和已经拥有的配件，询问能否初步判断。没有把握时，先诊断再采购；: Bring the model, a fault video, and accessories you already own, and ask for an initial assessment. Diagnose before buying uncertain nonreturnable parts, and count another trip in the cost. Ask whether photos can help assess a bulky item before transporting it.
准备一张故障卡：品牌型号、何时开始、怎样触发、是否间歇发生、已经尝试过什么。带电: Prepare a fault card with make/model, onset, trigger, whether it is intermittent, and what you have tried. Bring its power supply, special cables, manual, and relevant parts. An item that cannot demonstrate its fault can use up the session on missing accessories.
